status: reference definition and empirical proposal; full budgets and release qualification pending
rules: Reference recipes use supported Meson options; they do not add a build profile selector or change defaults.
Requested auto is not enabled proof. Every executed target records effective enabled/disabled/unavailable features from configure results.
Build features, all installed artifacts, resident processes and transient workers are separate populations. Common install bytes are not minimal runtime cost.
No profile automatically starts a new optional service. Each future optional extra needs an owning issue, supported implementation, parent identity and finite workload.
Compare only identical workload/config/environment/compiler/effective-feature/instrumentation populations; retain revision and artifact identities separately.
Linux/BSD AMD64/ARM64 are supported targets, not six passing measurements. The current receipt covers Linux ARM64 native instructions in an AppleHV VM only.
Numbers from different architectures, historical installs or GC-instrumented runs are never pooled.
No new default resident or mandatory dependency is accepted until its applicable numeric costs/envelopes have reviewed dispositions. Complete all budget rows before RC.

processes: fvwm3 measured CPU and peak RSS
minimal-instrumented-v1.config: DejaVu Sans size=10; TileCascadePlacement; generated fixed harness config
minimal-instrumented-v1.meaning: Command/Echo and scheduled-command latency; core proc CPU ticks and VmHWM. Synthetic X workload, not physical input-to-photon or redraw/X-request counts.

desktop-session-v1.work: Three editor open/close cycles, twelve settings queries, fixed application/search/files fixtures and menu/input exercise; see exact source hash and argv receipts.
desktop-session-v1.meaning: Ready = settings reply and bar window title, not completed first paint. Synthetic key/Echo timing, not physical input-to-photon. PID/start/executable tree coverage is partial when reported.

budget_policy.status: proposed empirical method for maintainer review; no automatic acceptance
budget_policy.formula: max + max(observed range, recorded counter quantum)
budget_policy.rationale: One observed repeat range, or one measured counter quantum when larger, gives an explicit empirical allowance. This is not a confidence interval or a universal percentage. Three repeats give a small reference, not a population tail bound.
budget_policy.incomplete: Missing value or partial/unavailable coverage yields no numeric envelope. Context-switch counts do not substitute for wakeups.
budget_policy.disposition: Above-envelope cost needs an attributed bounded fix, explicit reviewed budget revision, or release-blocking disposition. The helper reports observations only.

remaining_budget_rows.metric: steady and peak complete session RSS/PSS
remaining_budget_rows.gap: proc tree sampling may be partial; no complete total inferred; kernel charged peak is a different metric
existing delegated cgroup/trace endpoints required; no privilege/policy change in this batch
